cases.headline: Mighty Mouse told the speaker he spars too much

cases.annotation_reason: The NFL is mentioned as a quoted contrast about a sport the fighter could not play.

cases.headline: Sean Strickland told the speaker to abandon his UFC career
cases.annotation_reason: A quoted Sean Strickland remark concerns NFL or NBA ability, not advice to quit UFC.
